name: onyx-order-front
description: Onyx Order – front : site client (Next.js), écran cuisine et back-office (React + Vite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n site,cuisine,admin -c green,yellow,magenta "npm:dev -w web" "npm:dev -w cuisine" "npm:dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w cuisine && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w web
